why: Pet shops sell pet food, accessories and grooming services. They need FEFO food tracking, grooming slot scheduling and vet link hand-off. The key is FEFO pet food and grooming appointments.
operator: The pet shop owner manages pet food stock, accessories and grooming appointments. Their day is food stock checks, grooming slot scheduling and vet referral hand-offs.
entities: Shop (id, nameAr, nameEn, branchId, address, phone, currency, taxRegistration, openingHours)
Product (id, shopId, sku, nameAr, nameEn, type (food/toy/accessory), brand, weightKg (for food), pricePiasters, costPiasters, taxRate, fe4oFlag, expiryDate, stockQty, status, locationShelf)
GroomingAppointment (id, shopId, petName, petType, dateTime, duration, service (bath/trim/ full groom), pricePiasters, status, notes)
Customer (id, shopId, name, phone, optInWhatsApp, purchaseHistoryCount, totalSpentPiasters)
VetReferral (id, shopId, petName, petType, issue, referredTo, referredAt, status)
Staff (id, shopId, name, phone, role, hourlyRatePiasters, status)
batches: Yes for pet food: FEFO batches with supplier, received date, expiry date and cost, so the shop can sell by batch and claim credit
expiry: Pet food has expiry dates tracked per batch; the shop sees alerts for items expiring in 30/60/90 days
special: The core structures are the FEFO-tracked pet food, the grooming appointment with service type and duration, and the vet referral hand-off. FEFO food expiry is the key differentiator from regular retail.
screens: Product catalogue: grid of pet products with name, type, price, weight (for food), FEFO badge, expiry date badge, stock
Product detail: full info, batch details, supplier, reorder point, FEFO expiry alert
Grooming appointment scheduler: select service (bath/trim/full groom), date/time, pet name and type, set price, status (booked/in-progress/done)
Customer profile: name, phone, purchase history, opt-in WhatsApp, grooming history
FEFO food radar: items expiring in 30/60/90 days, value at risk, one-tap discount tag
Vet referral hand-off: enter issue, referred clinic, referral status (pending/accepted/rejected), date
Cash register: scan SKU or product, apply FEFO discount if urgent, tender payment, print receipt with FEFO note
Staff shift: clock in/out, customer load per hour, notes
roles: Owner: everything : inventory, grooming, vet referrals, reports, billing
Groomer: create grooming appointments, mark in-progress/done, update pet notes
Sales rep: manage product stock, create grooming appointments, handle vet referrals
Cashier: scan products, tender payment, print receipt
reports: Product sales by type: food vs toys vs accessories, revenue per type per period
FEFO food radar: items expiring in 30/60/90 days, value at risk, discounts applied
Grooming appointment pipeline: booked/in-progress/done counts per period, average duration
Customer retention: visit count per customer, total spent per customer, re-book rate
Vet referral status: pending/accepted/rejected counts per period
integrations: Esc/POS thermal printer for receipts and grooming completion notes
WhatsApp deep link for grooming ready notifications and vet referral follow-ups
onboarding: Shop basics: name, branch, address, phone, currency, working hours
Initial product list: the starting pet food and accessories with SKU, prices and FEFO flag
Grooming services: the service types (bath, trim, full groom) and pricing
Staff: add the initial team with their role templates
First week plan: receive first stock, create first grooming appointment, first vet referral
seed: No sector-specific seed data. The engine provides the FEFO pet food flag and role templates.

tasks.title: Add FEFO-tracked pet food catalogue
tasks.brief: Build the product catalogue: grid of pet products with name, type, price, weight (for food), FEFO badge, expiry date badge, stock. Done when the catalogue loads and displays products with FEFO badges and expiry dates correctly.
tasks.done: When product catalogue displays live data with FEFO tracking

tasks.title: Add grooming appointment scheduler
tasks.brief: Build the grooming appointment screen: select service (bath/trim/full groom), date/time, pet name and type, set price, status (booked/in-progress/done). Done when the appointment is saved and status updates propagate.
tasks.done: When grooming appointment scheduler works end-to-end with status tracking

tasks.title: Add FEFO food radar with expiry alerts
tasks.brief: Build the FEFO radar screen: items expiring in 30/60/90 days, value at risk, one-tap discount tag. Done when the radar pulls live data and the discount tag can be applied.
tasks.done: When FEFO radar works end-to-end with discount tag

tasks.title: Add customer profile with grooming history
tasks.brief: Build the customer profile: name, phone, purchase history, opt-in WhatsApp, grooming history. Done when the profile saves and displays correct data.
tasks.done: When customer profile works and displays live data

tasks.title: Add vet referral hand-off screen
tasks.brief: Build the referral screen: enter issue, referred clinic, referral status (pending/accepted/rejected), date. Done when the referral is saved and status updates propagate.
tasks.done: When vet referral hand-off works end-to-end with status tracking

tasks.title: Add cash register with FEFO discount
tasks.brief: Build the cash register: scan SKU or product, apply FEFO discount if urgent, tender payment, print receipt with FEFO note. Done when the sale applies the discount and receipt prints correctly.
tasks.done: When cash register works end-to-end with FEFO discount and receipt prints

tasks.title: Add grooming appointment pipeline report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing grooming appointments by status (booked/in-progress/done) and average duration per period. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When grooming pipeline report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add customer retention report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing visit count per customer, total spent per customer, re-book rate. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When customer retention report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add vet referral status report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing referral status (pending/accepted/rejected) counts per period. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When vet referral status report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add onboarding flow for initial pet shop setup
tasks.brief: Build the onboarding flow: shop basics, initial product list with FEFO flag, grooming services, staff addition. Done when the flow completes and the shop appears with all defaults.
tasks.done: When onboarding flow works end-to-end and shop is created

risks: Encryption key loss makes product and appointment records unrecoverable
WhatsApp template rejection if not approved by Meta
FEFO expiry without proper batch tracking can safety-compromise pets
Vet referral without documented hand-off can lead to lost follow-up
